page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin a column of quotation marks («) beside each line; running head and page number at the top; catchword and a signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: senserint, nihil tibi ex sententia debebitur, quia ego vicero: sin contra me pronunciaverint, nihil tibi ex pa-&to[?] debebo, quia ego non vi-cero.Tum judices dubiosum hoc inexplicabileq; esse,quod utrinq; dicebatur, rati, ne sententia sua utrãcunq;in parte dicta esset, ipsa sese rescinderet, rem injudicatam reliquerũt, causamq; in diem longissimam distulerunt. Sic ab a-dolescéte discipulo, magister disciplina eloquentiæ incly-tus, suo sibi argumento confutatus est, &captionis versutè excogitatæ frustatus est. Hęc Gellius. Nos aũt,quid hac de«

page.notes: Right margin: a column of « marks, one per line, transcribed as notes. Line 1 to 18 each have one; none on the last line. Possible printed errors: "fen" / "tentia" is split without a hyphen and joined as "sententia"; "pa-&to" is doubtful, the "&" may be a worn "c" (probably "pacto"), so it is marked [?]; "fentétia" carries an accent on the e as printed. Foot: "k" is a single mark at the foot left and is read as a signature; "re" at the foot right is the catchword. Spelling normalised: u/v and i/j per the rules, long s as s. Show-through and stains at the lower left are left out.
